summary: Delek Logistics Partners, LP filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $800 million aggregate principal amount of 6.875% senior notes due 2034 under an indenture dated May 14, 2026. The notes are general unsecured senior obligations of the issuers (the partnership and its finance subsidiary), guaranteed by certain existing and future subsidiaries. Interest is payable semi-annually, and the notes mature June 1, 2034. Optional redemption provisions allow up to 35% redemption before June 1, 2029 with net equity proceeds, or full redemption at make-whole premium. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
